premises.text: About 40% of bees die yearly from pesticides, parasites, and disease, threatening pollination-dependent food and beekeepers' honey and pollination businesses
premises.evidence_span: Every year, we lose about 40% of our bees because of pesticides, parasites, and diseases

premises.text: Beekeepers must physically open each hive to assess status, which does not scale across large multi-site operations and often discovers problems too late
premises.evidence_span: To get an idea of what's going on inside their hives, they have to physically go to every single one of them and open them up to look inside

premises.text: Nectar is a beehive management platform using sensors and AI so keepers can remotely track health and behavior and prevent disease
premises.evidence_span: a beehive management platform using sensors and AI. With Nectar, the beekeepers can remotely follow their hive status in terms of health and behavior in order to improve their decision-making process and really prevent diseases instead of reacting to them

premises.text: In-hive sensors translate temperature, humidity, sound, weight, and geolocation signals into a human-readable interface
premises.evidence_span: The beekeepers install our sensor devices in the hive, and we translate its temperature, humidity, sound frequencies, or really the signals that the bees send each other, the weight of the hive and its geolocation, and translate it into an interface understandable by us humans

premises.text: Differentiation is affordable analytics rather than expensive raw data, supporting more profitable apiaries
premises.evidence_span: We offer affordable analytics instead of expensive raw data

premises.text: Revenue is subscription plans with one to three analytic packages targeting crucial hive places
premises.evidence_span: We offer three different plans with a choice of one, two, or three analytic packages in order to really follow specific places in the hive that are crucial for beekeepers
